name: Patchwork Ego
source:
Three warlocks and a hunter set out on an adventure to save an eldritch creature from evil druids. What could go wrong?

While Patchwork Ego is technically a sequel to [url=/v32633]Perfection | Paper-thin[/url], it can be read as a standalone.

[From [url=https://crazycowlady.itch.io/patchwork-ego]Itch.io[/url]]
